caption:
Six layout rules are checked on the rendered page after every edit.

JobRez measures the rendered document against concrete structural constraints: single-column order, standard headings, real bullet lists, selectable text, no tables or floats, and body text of at least 9.5pt.

This measurement is an audit of document geometry, not a certification against any ATS vendor. The system enforces layout hygiene without speculative scoring.

Read more at jobrez.com.

#JobRez #ResumeEngineering #MasterResume #TechResume #ResumeDesign #CareerOps

slides.heading: Six layout rules
slides.body: Checked on the rendered page after every edit. Measuring document geometry rather than guessing vendor logic.
slides.altText: Slide 1 titled Six layout rules explaining checks on the rendered page after every edit.

slides.heading: Reading order and headings
slides.body: Single-column order prevents fragmented parsing streams. Standard headings define clean section boundaries across every export.
slides.altText: Slide 2 titled Reading order and headings covering single-column flow and standard headings.

slides.heading: Lists and text stream
slides.body: Real bullet lists replace faux bullet characters. Selectable text ensures raw characters export cleanly without glyph corruption.
slides.altText: Slide 3 titled Lists and text stream detailing real bullet lists and selectable text.

slides.heading: Layout limits and sizing
slides.body: No tables or floats to break reading hierarchy. Body text of at least 9.5pt guarantees legibility on every rendered branch.
slides.altText: Slide 4 titled Layout limits and sizing outlining no tables or floats and minimum 9.5pt text.

slides.heading: Structural enforcement
slides.body: Measured live on the rendered page. Note: this check is not a certification against any ATS vendor.
slides.altText: Slide 5 titled Structural enforcement noting it is not a certification against any ATS vendor.
